historical_fox_clone_arms.interpretation: Every clone arm inherits the reference's two word changes. The no-reference control says fox/dog. The 2/9 WER is the reference's pronunciation, not a decode or DSP regression.

interpretation: The 2/9 gate failure was the reference, not the port. `fox.wav` renders its own text as "fex/fixed ... dig" under both independent ASR architectures, and every historical clone arm (native legacy/punctuation/reference-cleanup/output-cleanup and upstream unprocessed/full-cleanup) inherited exactly those two words while the no-reference control said "fox/dog". The harness now transcribes each fixture with an RNNT and a CTC model before any cloning, refuses a reference that no engine can read back, and scores clones on two sentences that are not the reference text. `window.wav` reads back at 0.000 on both engines and is the only gated reference. Every arm is <= 0.111 against the unchanged 0.2 gate; the residual is Nemotron dropping the leading "The" on cloned speech (1/9), which the second target does not share (0.000).
not_claimed: no change to the OmniVoice codec/license hold and no merge
no threshold relaxation, no seed selection, no fixture-outcome selection
fox.wav stays unusable as a cloning gate reference; it is kept as the known-bad control

station.wav is readable audio but not a gate reference: parakeet splits "tomorrow" ("to morrow", 0.222) and the clone reads back as "lazy lady" under nemotron, which a 9-word WER judge cannot separate from a port defect
a frozen upstream-vs-native cloning comparison on fox.wav is moot until it uses a vetted reference; none is claimed here
rerun_reproducibility: Two full runs (harness sources 8c9898239 and 123298600) produced byte-identical PCM for all seven arms and identical reference transcripts at seed 42.

audit_correction.reason: station satisfies min_wer <= 0.2 but was excluded because its clone failed. Measured per-arm results are retained, but overall acceptance is rejected; historical_selected_subset_passed preserves the original subset outcome.
audit_correction.required: Run the corrected harness with every eligible reference; do not infer pronunciation causality or full native/upstream parity from ASR agreement.
